system.description:
You wave your hands back and forth creating layers of wind that stack on top of one another creating a shield of wind. Your shield of wind is dense not allowing most things to pass through it. When you create your barrier of wind it has 30 Hit points. It occupies your space with you and protects you in all directions, ranged attacks targeting you are made at disadvantage.

At the start of each of your turns you can spend a bonus action to restabilize this barrier regenerating 2d6 of the shields hit points. This barrier has a vulnerability to Fire damage, and resistance to Lightning damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the hit points of the barrier by 8.
